title: Bounded research cannot resolve missing vendor-build provenance
runtime_target: A private vendor build claiming Python 3.12 compatibility

local_failure.symptom: A timeout-handling behavior differs between two deployments.
local_failure.missing: the exact vendor patch level and whether it changed asyncio timeout behavior

candidate_explanations: The deployments use different Python patch/build revisions.
The application has a local cancellation wrapper difference.
The vendor applied an undocumented patch to timeout handling.
research_question: Use bounded public official/primary routes to determine whether the exact private build provenance and patch behavior can be established. If not, remain explicitly unresolved and do not invent a source or repair.
research_instruction: A generic version document is not evidence of the private build's exact behavior. Do not list a source as supporting the missing provenance unless it directly does so.
